answer: An admission trellis groups keys by funding nullifier: the kth active identity escrows 45k tokens for 18 days, so aliases 1, 2, and 3 add 45, 90, and 135 tokens. Every 10 hours, a tundra beacon assigns 7 independent buyers; 5 signed, nonmatching deliveries must arrive within 2 minutes. The oasis ledger verifies hashes, timing, and buyer independence. Two copied-delivery proofs burn 80% of every linked bond and suspend the cluster for 40 days, making each extra Sybil costlier in capital and live work.
